caption: The drawing contains a large, stylized bird on the left side, primarily in shades of red, green, and brown. The bird has a curved neck, a prominent eye, a green wing with a red outline, and a red head with scalloped detailing; its tail extends to the lower left corner with red and yellow feathers. To the right of the bird, the central area features a large heart outlined with floral and vine patterns, inside of which is German text written in calligraphic script in black ink. Around the heart, there are various decorative elements: at the top right, a semicircular red object with yellow spikes resembling a sun or crown; at the upper left, a small pink and red flower with green leaves; at the bottom, several stylized, multicolored flowers, one with a face; a ribbon-like figure in red and yellow on the lower left; looping green vines with leaves and spirals; and a bowl-shaped object with a brown base and green and yellow top at the bottom right. A smaller heart, outlined with dots, appears below the center left of the main heart, also containing German text. The background is a tan color, and the paper appears aged, with visible creases and stains. The name "ALBERT LEVONE" is printed near the bottom right corner outside the main illustration.
title: Portion of Birth Certificate
